name: Seenarr
tagline: A self-hosted, permanent TV watch history. A Trakt replacement that you own.
description: Seenarr keeps a complete record of every episode you've watched, fed automatically from Plex and organised by your Sonarr library, with episode data from TVmaze. Your history lives in one SQLite file on your own server.
features: Continue Watching, new episodes and Coming Soon dashboard
Automatic Plex history sync and optional webhook
Sonarr library as your show list
Trakt and Prime Video history imports with preview
Append-only watch history that resyncs cannot undo
